Name: Bonster's Greenhouses
Author: rjgilber
Description:
Who wouldn't love a larger greenhouse?  This mod offers plenty of space for both field crops and trees, including special fields for trellis crops.  Iridium Greenhouse is sized for iridium sprinklers, with the majority of the fields being 5x5 squares.  The Prismatic Greenhouse features 7x7 fields.  It's best not to wonder how the door works.

How to install:
- Make sure you have SMAPI and Content Patcher
- Download your preferred greenhouse and unzip file folder
- Drop the unzipped file into your mods folder
- Play

IMPORTANT NOTE: You can use this in an established game.  However, if you have crops in your greenhouse, changing your map will potentially cost you crops.  Make sure your greenhouse is empty before you change the map.
